मेचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Black, dark, of a dark, or black colour.
 m. (-कः)
1. Black or dark-blue, (the colour.)
 2. The eye of a peacock's tail.
3. A cloud.
 4.

. A nipple.
 6. A plant, (Hyperanthera
morunga.)
 mn. (-कः-कं) Darkness.
 n. (-कं) Sulphuret of antimony.
E. मच् to mix, Unādi aff. वुन्, and the vowel changed to ए ।

मेचकापगा f. (-गा) The Yamunā river.
 E. मेचक dark, and अपगा the river.
